description: NaNiPO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NiO₆ pentagonal pyramids, corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NiO₆ pentagonal pyramids, and edges with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.38 Å. Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NiO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NiO₆ pentagonal pyramids, corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 64-72°. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.23 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NiO₆ pentagonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NiO₆ pentagonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 59°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.58 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ni, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ni, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ni, and one P atom.
